# hyperfine.LevelF { #clerq.hyperfine.LevelF }

```python
hyperfine.LevelF(
    I,
    J,
    F,
    energy=0.0,
    mF_energies=None,
    g_F=None,
    g_J=None,
    g_I=0.0,
    L=None,
)
```

Represents an F hyperfine structure level and holds its magnetic
    sublevels mF.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type              | Description                             |
|-----------|-------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| F         | float             | Total atomic angular momentum number F. |
| energy    | float             | Energy of the level.                    |
| mf_levels | list, length 2F+1 | Energies of 2F+1 hyperfine sublevels.   |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- The magnitude of F can take values in the range
    `|J - I| <= F <= J + I`. A ``ValueError`` is raised if this is
    not satisfied.
- The mF_energies are set _relative_ to the F level energy.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [build_mF_levels](#clerq.hyperfine.LevelF.build_mF_levels) | Builds the mF sublevels of the F level. |
| [get_mF_range](#clerq.hyperfine.LevelF.get_mF_range) | Returns a range representing the m_F angular momentum sublevels |

### build_mF_levels { #clerq.hyperfine.LevelF.build_mF_levels }

```python
hyperfine.LevelF.build_mF_levels(mF_energies=None)
```

Builds the mF sublevels of the F level.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type              | Description                               | Default   |
|-------------|-------------------|-------------------------------------------|-----------|
| mF_energies | list, length 2F+1 | Energies of the 2F+1 hyperfine sublevels. | `None`    |

Returns:
    self.mF_levels

### get_mF_range { #clerq.hyperfine.LevelF.get_mF_range }

```python
hyperfine.LevelF.get_mF_range()
```

Returns a range representing the m_F angular momentum sublevels
[-F, -F+1, ..., F-1, F].
